flask-static-catchall.python_justification: Flask 1.1.1 supports Python 2.7/3.5+ (setup.py python_requires: >=2.7, !=3.0-3.4). Python 3.8.18 is within supported range.

flask-json-datetime-tz.python_justification: Flask 0.12.2 supports Python 2.6/2.7/3.3-3.6 (setup.py classifiers). Python 3.6.15 is the latest patch release and is the final version officially supported by this release. Python 3.6 is not available on Ubuntu 22.04 host (deadsnakes PPA only supports 3.7+ on Jammy due to OpenSSL 3 incompatibility).

python_pip_alignment.requirement: python and pip MUST refer to the same Python installation
python_pip_alignment.validation: python -m pip --version must show the same version as python --version
python_pip_alignment.note: Frozen Flask commands invoke bare `pip`. PATH must resolve pip to the same interpreter.

notes.windows_support: Windows is NOT an official benchmark execution platform. Windows may be used for: validate, plan, isolation-check, repository planning/development only.
notes.frozen_specs: Historical task commands (pip, tail, pnpm) are frozen and MUST NOT be rewritten for platform compatibility. The canonical environment MUST satisfy them.
notes.container_runtimes: Tasks with executor=container run in pinned Docker containers. The container persists across setup, pre-validation, and regression commands within a single benchmark run.
